why: The bank-name grammar is enforced in three places: admin.NormalizeBank (Go),
app/src/lib/bank.ts (the client, so a user is refused BEFORE the request
with a message naming the rule instead of after it with a generic 400).
They disagreed. The client accepted any non-control string of <= 64 CODE
POINTS while the server accepted a narrow ASCII shape measured in BYTES, so
'Mashreq (UAE)' was a 400 that surfaced as 'Could not add that bank. Try
again.' on a step the user could not get past. This file is what stops the
app/src/lib/bank.test.ts both drive every case below, and a grammar change
made to one side only fails the other side's suite.
'normalized' is the stored form and is asserted only when ok is true.
